description: Full Observability Stack - Add Prometheus + Grafana to docker-compose for metrics visualization, structured JSON logging with correlation IDs, and pre-built Grafana dashboards. Extend existing Prometheus metrics with provider-specific counters and document translation metrics.
steps: Create monitoring/prometheus/prometheus.yml - Prometheus config that scrapes the API at :8000/metrics every 15s. Include job labels and scrape targets for api and worker services.
Create monitoring/grafana/provisioning/datasources/prometheus.yml - auto-provision Prometheus as data source in Grafana.
Create monitoring/grafana/provisioning/dashboards/dashboard.yml - provisioning config for dashboard auto-loading.

Create monitoring/grafana/dashboards/deeplv-overview.json - Grafana dashboard JSON with panels: request rate, latency percentiles, cache hit rate, translations by provider, active users, error rate, document jobs status.

Update docker-compose.yml to add prometheus service (prom/prometheus:latest, port 9090, mounts prometheus.yml), grafana service (grafana/grafana:latest, port 3001, mounts provisioning and dashboards, env vars for anonymous auth).

Update src/api/metrics.py - add new counters/histograms: deeplv_provider_translations_total (by provider), deeplv_document_jobs_total (by status), deeplv_credits_spent_total, deeplv_active_provider_keys_gauge.
Update src/shared/logging.py to ensure structlog outputs JSON format with timestamp, level, request_id, user_id fields for production log aggregation.
Add a /metrics endpoint to the worker service (src/worker/main.py) exposing worker-specific metrics (model load time, inference latency by language pair).
Update Dockerfile.api and Dockerfile.worker to include any needed dependencies for metrics.
acceptance_criteria: docker compose config validates successfully with prometheus and grafana services
Prometheus config correctly targets API and worker /metrics endpoints
Grafana provisions with Prometheus data source and at least one dashboard automatically
New metrics track: translations by provider, document jobs, credits spent
Worker exposes /metrics endpoint with Prometheus format
Structured logging outputs valid JSON with correlation fields
Grafana accessible at port 3001 with no login required (anonymous auth enabled)
verification: Run docker compose config to validate the compose file syntax
Run python -c 'from src.api.metrics import PROVIDER_TRANSLATION_COUNT; print("OK")' to verify new metrics exist
Run python -c 'import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open("monitoring/prometheus/prometheus.yml")); print("Valid YAML")' to check prometheus config
findings: Tests have pre-existing failures due to Python 3.9 runtime vs 3.11 requirement (type union syntax in cache.py) and missing ftlangdetect module. These are not related to FEAT-004 changes. Docker compose plugin not available in sandbox so config validation was done with PyYAML instead. All new metrics verified importable and functional. Structured JSON logging verified with correlation fields (request_id, user_id, timestamp, level). Worker /metrics endpoint added with model load time and inference latency histograms.
